rows.label: DEBT LIMIT

rows.label: WINNINGS

rows.label: FARMSTEAD

rows.label: RETAINER

rows.label: PENSION FUND

rows.label: BIG MONEY
rows.clue: A large sum of money (especially as pay or profit)

rows.label: DEBENTURE

rows.label: PAYROLL

rows.label: PASSIVE TRUST

rows.label: FOREIGN BILL
rows.clue: A bill of exchange that is drawn in one country and made payable in another

rows.label: PAPER MONEY
rows.clue: Currency issued by a government or central bank and consisting of printed paper that can circulate as a substitute for specie

rows.label: ANNUITY
rows.clue: Income from capital investment paid in a series of regular payments

rows.label: PETTY CASH

rows.label: SUBVENTION

rows.label: SUBSCRIPTION

rows.label: BUDGET ITEMS
rows.clue: The expense of maintaining property (e.g., paying property taxes and utilities and insurance)

rows.label: PROFIT SHARING

rows.label: CURRENCY

rows.clue: Insurance issued jointly by two or more underwriters
